items: Your Recommended To-Do List has steps that you should take to get the best results from your meds.
Your Medication List will help you keep track of what you take and how to take it.

English: Your Recommended To-Do List has steps that you should take to get the best results from your medications.
Your Medication List will help you keep track of what you take and how to take it.
Your child's Recommended To-Do List has steps that they should take to get the best results from their meds.
Your child's Medication List will help you keep track of what they take and how to take it.
Spanish: La lista de tareas recomendadas de su hijo(a) tiene pasos que deben tomar para obtener los mejores resultados de sus medicamentos.
La lista de medicamentos de su hijo(a) lo ayudará a llevar un registro de lo que toma y cómo tomarlo.

Your child's Medication List that will help you keep track of what your child takes and how to take it.

English: Your Recommended To-Do List has steps that you should take to get the best results from your medications.
Your Medication List will help you keep track of what you take and how to take it.

Spanish: La lista de actividades recomendadas incluye las medidas que debería tomar para aprovechar al máximo sus medicamentos.
La lista de medicamentos le permitirá llevar un registro de los medicamentos que toma y de la manera en que los toma.

paragraph.string: I look forward to working with you and your doctors to make sure your meds work well for you.

centene:medicaid:absolute_total_care:atc.English: I look forward to working with you and your doctors to make sure your medications work well for you.

centene:medicaid:arkansas_total_care:tot.English: I look forward to working with you and your doctors to make sure your medications work well for you.

centene:medicaid:childrens_medical_servi.English: I look forward to working with you and your child's doctors to make sure your child's meds work well for them.
centene:medicaid:childrens_medical_servi.Spanish: Espero con interés trabajar con usted y los médicos de su hijo(a) para asegurarme de que los medicamentos de su hijo(a) funcionen bien para ellos.

centene:medicaid:fidelis_care:medicaid_w.English: I look forward to working with you and your primary care provider (PCP) to make sure your meds work well for you.
centene:medicaid:fidelis_care:medicaid_w.Spanish: Espero poder trabajar con usted y con su proveedor de atención primaria (PCP) para garantizarle que los medicamentos que toma sean efectivos para usted.

centene:medicaid:managed_health_services.English: I look forward to working with you and your doctors to make sure your medications work well for you.

centene:medicaid:sunshine_health:sshp:fl.Spanish: Espero con interés trabajar con usted y sus médicos para asegurarme de que sus medicamentos funcionen bien para ellos.

centene:medicaid:sunshine_health:sshp:fl.English: I look forward to working with you, your child, and their doctors to make sure your child’s meds are working well for them.
centene:medicaid:sunshine_health:sshp:fl.Spanish: Espero con interés trabajar con usted, su hijo(a) y sus médicos para asegurarme de que los medicamentos de su hijo(a) estén funcionando bien para ellos.

centene:medicaid:superior_healthplan:sup.English: I look forward to working with you and your doctors to make sure your medications work well for you.

default.Spanish: Espero poder trabajar con usted y con sus médicos para garantizarle que los medicamentos que toma sean efectivos para usted.

table_items.string: According to the Paperwork Reduction Act of 1995, no persons are required to respond to a collection of information unless it displays a valid OMB control number. The valid OMB number for this information collection is 0938-1154. The time required to complete this information collection is estimated to average 40 minutes per response, including the time to review instructions, searching existing data resources, gather the data needed, and complete and review the information collection. If you have any comments concerning the accuracy of the time estimate(s) or suggestions for improving this form, please write to: CMS, Attn: PRA Reports Clearance Officer, 7500 Security Boulevard, Baltimore, Maryland 21244-1850
